title: 2032 — First long-duration copy fidelity testbed runs a sealed probe hu

description:
First long-duration copy fidelity testbed runs a sealed probe hulls habitat for 1,000 days on Earth, proving the replicator bays recycling math.

What must be true first: the replicator bays results have to replicate outside the lab, probe propulsion manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and resource harvesting operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed replicator bays demonstrations, probe propulsion cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting resource harvesting uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

t: Readiness Estimator: Von Neumann Explorer Probes
title: Readiness Estimator: Von Neumann Explorer Probes
definition: Estimates Von Neumann Explorer Probes readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Von Neumann Explorer Probes components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a probe hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

t: Von Neumann Explorer Probes Systems Simulator
title: Von Neumann Explorer Probes Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Von Neumann Explorer Probes operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Von Neumann Explorer Probes installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 70304 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where replicator bays monitoring, probe propulsion redundancy, or resource harvesting maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

t: Von Neumann Explorer Probes Master Roadmap
title: Von Neumann Explorer Probes Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Von Neumann Explorer Probes: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Von Neumann Explorer Probes — self-replicating probes mapping the galaxy exponentially.

Phase 1 — Prove (replicator bays): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (probe propulsion): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (resource harvesting): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (copy fidelity): probe hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and galaxy-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
